page: Microsoft Azure HB176rs_v4 is a high-performance server instance belonging to the HBv4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 176 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture and an Intel processor. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 4.36 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes 4332 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. Additionally, the instance is RDMA capable, enabling low-latency, high-throughput networking interfaces suitable for clustered environments. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

Given the high density of dedicated vCPUs, substantial local NVMe storage, and RDMA capabilities, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile for parallel computing tasks. It is designed for high-performance computing workloads, large-scale simulations, computational fluid dynamics, and database-heavy applications requiring fast local storage and inter-node communication, presenting a resource-dense profile for clustered deployments.
